finding: Slovak firms' bank loan availability expectations diverged from improving EA trend
bullets: A net 6.5% of Slovak firms (n=104) expected bank loan availability to deteriorate in wave 39—suggesting tightening conditions ahead for local borrowers.
Slovak firms' trade credit expectations improved 4.0 pp to a net 6.2% expecting deterioration (n=90), while EA firms saw only a 1.0 pp rise to 1.9%.

Credit line availability expectations improved for both SK and EA firms, with Slovak firms' net deterioration share falling 3.2 pp to 3.9% (n=136)—signalling slightly better short-term liquidity prospects.
chart_subtitle: Net 6.5% of Slovak firms expect bank loan availability to deteriorate.
